## Enumerated constants

### `entasis_body_control_wake_t`

awakening policy for queued body controls

| Constant                              | Value | Meaning                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------- | ----: | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_CONTROL_WAKE`           |   `0` | awaken and reset sleep activity before integration                                |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_CONTROL_PRESERVE_SLEEP` |   `1` | queue until the body next integrates. sleeping time contributes no input duration |

### `entasis_body_input_mode_t`

continuous input units

| Constant                          | Value | Meaning                                                            |
| --------------------------------- | ----: | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_INPUT_FORCE`        |   `0` | force uses inverse mass. torque uses current world inverse inertia |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_INPUT_ACCELERATION` |   `1` | mass-independent linear or angular acceleration                    |

### `entasis_body_damping_mode_t`

composition of per-body exponential damping

| Constant                          | Value | Meaning                                                    |
| --------------------------------- | ----: | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_DAMPING_ADDITIONAL` |   `0` | apply after the existing integration callback              |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_DAMPING_OVERRIDE`   |   `1` | replace damping only in a recognized native gravity policy |

### `entasis_body_lock_axes_t`

physical axis-lock row selection

| Constant                 | Value | Meaning                                      |
| ------------------------ | ----: | -------------------------------------------- |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_LOCK_NONE` |   `0` | no rows on this component                    |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_LOCK_X`    |   `1` | X coordinate or reference-frame angular axis |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_LOCK_Y`    |   `2` | Y coordinate or reference-frame angular axis |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_LOCK_Z`    |   `4` | Z coordinate or reference-frame angular axis |
| `ENTASIS_BODY_LOCK_ALL`  |   `7` | all three axes                               |

## Callback types

### `entasis_static_awakening_filter_fn`

selects which overlapping sleeping-body islands may wake during one static mutation

```c
typedef entasis_bool_t (ENTASIS_CALL *entasis_static_awakening_filter_fn)(void * user_context, entasis_body_handle_t body);
```

| Parameter      | C type                  | Meaning                                                                 |
| -------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `user_context` | `void *`                | caller-owned callback state, borrowed until the static mutation returns |
| `body`         | `entasis_body_handle_t` | sleeping dynamic body whose island overlaps the changed static          |

returns true to allow waking the body island

| `minimum_timesteps_under_threshold` | `uint8_t` | consecutive steps required below the sleep threshold |

returns the activity description

### `entasis_body_add`

adds one body

allocation may occur when world capacity grows. ownership: owner thread only while the world is idle

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_add(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_body_description_t * description, entasis_body_handle_t * out_handle, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter     | C type                               | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`       | `entasis_world_t *`                  | target world                                                                 |
| `description` | `const entasis_body_description_t *` | body description to copy                                                     |
| `out_handle`  | `entasis_body_handle_t *`            | receives the created body handle                                             |
| `diagnostic`  | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`             | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_body_add_batch`

adds a prefix of descriptions in input order after one capacity check

out_handles must contain at least count entries. on failure, out_completed receives the number of successfully committed prefix entries and entries at or after that index remain invalid. allocation: the initial capacity check may grow world storage. ownership: owner thread only while the world is idle

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_add_batch(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_body_description_t * descriptions, uint64_t count, entasis_body_handle_t * out_handles, uint64_t * out_completed, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter       | C type                               | Meaning                                                                      |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`         | `entasis_world_t *`                  | target world                                                                 |
| `descriptions`  | `const entasis_body_description_t *` | input body description array                                                 |
| `count`         | `uint64_t`                           | number of entries in the input arrays                                        |
| `out_handles`   | `entasis_body_handle_t *`            | receives body handles in input order                                         |
| `out_completed` | `uint64_t *`                         | receives the number of successfully completed prefix entries                 |
| `diagnostic`    | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`             | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

accumulates world-space force or linear acceleration

dynamic bodies only. repeated submissions add for one integrated step over actual substep durations. zero does not awaken. executed input is consumed even if later physics fails. prediction never consumes it

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_add_force(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_body_handle_t body, entasis_vector3_t force, entasis_body_input_mode_t mode, entasis_body_control_wake_t wake, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                        | Meaning                                                                       |
| ------------ | ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`           | idle live world. mutations reject read phases and callback reentry            |
| `body`       | `entasis_body_handle_t`       | live body handle                                                              |
| `force`      | `entasis_vector3_t`           | finite world-space vector                                                     |
| `mode`       | `entasis_body_input_mode_t`   | force or acceleration units                                                   |
| `wake`       | `entasis_body_control_wake_t` | explicit wake policy. choose ENTASIS_BODY_CONTROL_WAKE for the native default |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`      | optional diagnostic output                                                    |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK or the original failure status

### `entasis_body_add_force_at_position`

the wrench is frozen at submission. position is not a local-space attachment and is not updated as the body rotates

### `entasis_body_set_kinematic_target`

queues a next-step kinematic target

derives linear and shortest-arc angular velocity for the step. ordinary pose integration and collision response apply. no obstacle-resolving teleport. executed targets expire on failure as well as success

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_set_kinematic_target(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_body_handle_t body, const entasis_rigid_pose_t * target, entasis_body_control_wake_t wake, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                         | Meaning                                                                       |
| ------------ | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`            | idle live world. mutations reject read phases and callback reentry            |
| `body`       | `entasis_body_handle_t`        | live body handle                                                              |
| `target`     | `const entasis_rigid_pose_t *` | required copied finite pose with unit quaternion                              |
| `wake`       | `entasis_body_control_wake_t`  | explicit wake policy. choose ENTASIS_BODY_CONTROL_WAKE for the native default |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`       | optional diagnostic output                                                    |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK or the original failure status

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_get_kinematic_target(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_body_handle_t body, entasis_rigid_pose_t * out_target, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

creates a descriptor with no axes and spring frequency 30 Hz, damping ratio 1

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_body_axis_lock_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_axis_lock_default(entasis_rigid_pose_t reference);
```

| ----------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `reference` | `entasis_rigid_pose_t` | captured reference pose |

returns copied defaults. select axes before applying

### `entasis_body_set_axis_lock`

sets or updates a physical axis lock on a dynamic body

awakens a sleeping island. failure publishes no new lock. existing references are not reanchored by later pose edits. uses engine-owned constraint type 48, not caller IDs

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_set_axis_lock(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_body_handle_t body, const entasis_body_axis_lock_t * description, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter     | C type                             | Meaning                                          |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `world`       | `entasis_world_t *`                | live world with body control enabled             |
| `body`        | `entasis_body_handle_t`            | live body handle                                 |
| `description` | `const entasis_body_axis_lock_t *` | descriptor copied before awakening or allocation |
| `diagnostic`  | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`           | optional diagnostic output                       |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK or the original failure status

### `entasis_body_get_axis_lock`

copies active or sleeping lock settings without awakening

returns NOT_FOUND when no lock exists. no borrowed pointer or allocation. the existing body constraint list is authoritative

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_get_axis_lock(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_body_handle_t body, entasis_body_axis_lock_t * output, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                       | Meaning                                            |
| ------------ | ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`          | live world with body control enabled               |
| `body`       | `entasis_body_handle_t`      | live body handle                                   |
| `output`     | `entasis_body_axis_lock_t *` | written only on success, with current size/version |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`     | optional diagnostic output                         |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK or the original failure status

### `entasis_body_clear_axis_lock`

removes only the owned axis lock, leaving explicit joints intact

a live body without a lock succeeds. removing a sleeping lock can awaken the island and fail on capacity. retry does not lose the remaining lock


returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK or the original failure status
